title: Senior Project Manager - SAP Security & Cybersecurity @ Brazil
description:
Location: Brazil @ Remote

Employment Type: Contract / Full-Time

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager with a strong background in SAP Security, Information Security Operations, Controls, and Cybersecurity . This role requires a proven track record of managing complex security projects, excellent communication skills, and the ability to bridge the gap between SAP technical teams and broader cybersecurity/information security functions.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving SAP security initiatives, overseeing general infosec operations, and ensuring compliance with industry standards and controls.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage SAP security and cybersecurity projects across enterprise landscapes.
  • Oversee SAP security operations including roles, authorizations, and GRC controls.
  • Collaborate with SAP BASIS, Security, GRC, and Cybersecurity teams to ensure best practices and compliance.
  • Develop and enforce information security policies, standards, and controls aligned with corporate governance and regulatory frameworks.
  • Conduct risk assessments, track remediation activities, and manage mitigation plans.
  • Align SAP security initiatives with overall cybersecurity strategy and enterprise risk management .
  • Provide regular updates, risk reporting, and metrics to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Mentor and guide project teams on cybersecurity operations, controls, and SAP security frameworks .

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of IT/security experience, with at least 5+ years in SAP Security project management .
  • Strong background in general cybersecurity operations, infosec controls, and compliance frameworks .
  • Expertise in SAP roles, authorizations, GRC, and access control models .
  • Knowledge of security standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, SOX, GDPR .
  • Experience managing large-scale SAP implementation or transformation projects with security focus.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills – ability to translate technical risks into business terms.
  • PMP, CISM, CISA, or CISSP certifications preferred.
  • Fluency in English required; Spanish a strong plus.

Why Join Us?

  • Lead critical SAP security and cybersecurity initiatives for a global enterprise.
  • Remote opportunity based in Argentina with international collaboration.
  • Competitive compensation and long-term growth potential.

title: Cientista de dados Pleno
description:
Sobre a ConCrédito

A ConCrédito é especialista em antecipação do saque FGTS, com mais de 300 mil clientes ativos e operações em forte crescimento. Estamos em busca de um Analista de Dados Pleno para fortalecer nosso time de Data & Growth, ajudando a transformar grandes volumes de dados em insights estratégicos que impulsionem a aquisição, a retenção e o crescimento da receita da empresa.

Sua missão

Construir análises e dashboards que permitam monitorar o funil de vendas e a performance dos canais digitais e de growth, apoiando decisões estratégicas e garantindo que a ConCrédito aproveite ao máximo sua base de clientes.

Você será a referência em dados para o time, assegurando qualidade, organização e clareza nas informações utilizadas pelas áreas de Comercial, Marketing e IA.

Como será seu dia a dia

  • Estruturar e manter dashboards estratégicos e operacionais em Power BI e Metabase.

O que buscamos

  • Experiência sólida em SQL (avançado).
  • Vivência com Snowflake.
  • Experiência em Power BI e Metabase para criação de dashboards.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com foco em funil de vendas e KPIs de conversão.
  • Boa comunicação para traduzir dados complexos em informações acessíveis a diferentes áreas.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em operações de vendas digitais de alto volume.

Por que entrar na ConCrédito?

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software (Back-End) - Sênior
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.

Missão do cargo:

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software você fará parte de um dos times de desenvolvimento e será responsável por agregar conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo ou construindo parte das soluções de nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, buscando soluções para situações do dia a dia, visando sempre o trabalho harmônico em equipe, a qualidade do código e da arquitetura em geral.

Como será o seu dia a dia no time:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, participando e fomentando práticas de Code Review e desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos.
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Java, Golang e NodeJS
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços
  • Trabalhar com modelo de dados hierárquico e de grafos
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões altos de performance
  • Observar o desenvolvimento seguro e estar sempre por dentro de atualizações de segurança e critérios relevantes relacionados ao desenvolvimento seguro

#Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Idealizar e construir novas soluções (análise e desenvolvimento);
  • Conceber melhorias nas arquiteturas atuais e de novas soluções;
  • Suportar questões técnicas dos projetos, em suas diversas fases, propondo soluções, indagando caminhos. Sempre de forma crítica e construtiva;
  • Recomendar modificações e melhorias em processos, visando a eficiência das áreas;
  • Solucionar/encaminhar ou ainda escalar impedimentos técnicos apontados pelo time;
  • Contribuir com o crescimento técnico do time, efetuando treinamentos, aconselhamentos (mentoria) e supervisão de pessoas desenvolvedoras menos experientes, sempre que necessário;
  • Contribuir para a produção de padrões e documentação de melhores práticas para a sua equipe e garantir que o desenvolvimento atenda a esses padrões;
  • Apoiar em práticas de desenvolvimento ágil.

#Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas para processamento de grandes volumes de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, desenvolvimento orientado a testes, escrita e documentação de códigos, code review, etc);
  • Conhecimento intermediário ou avançado em linguagem para back-end;
  • Linguagens de programação (Go, NodeJS, SQL);
  • Banco de dados relacionais, não relacionais, colunares/AVRO e elásticos (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc);
  • Estrutura Cloud (GCP);
  • Pró-eficiência no desenvolvimento de: API Rest; Programação concorrente e escalável;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento e práticas CI/CD;
  • Experiência com práticas de Code Review e Feedback;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento;
  • Promover nossa cultura e valores;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe.

Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Conhecimento dos conceitos de Big Data, Data Lake, Metadados com as perspectiva das boas práticas e requisitos de governança de dados;
  • Teoria e prática em qualidade de dados (Dimensões, Profiling, Data Quality Assessment);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Go;
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura (Terraform, Ansible);
  • Conhecimento em schedulers (Crontab, Jenkins, Airflow, etc);
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de containers (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimento em serviços de mensageria (SNS, Kafka).
  • Conhecimento de BigQuery, ElasticSearch

title: Tax Manager
description:
Why Valmont

We’re Here to Move the World Forward.

Valmont impacts millions of people around the world every day, yet they might not realize the many ways. Our technology is helping feed the growing population, supplying the world with more reliable energy and access to renewables, enhancing connectivity in remote and urban locations to create a sustainable future and so much more. Simply put, Valmont is advancing agricultural productivity and reimagining vital infrastructure to make life better.

Join a Fortune 1000 company that respects hard work, honors diversity and invests in our employees as we focus on creating the world of tomorrow, today. We are the modern workforce . Are you ready to move the world forward? Apply now.

Why Valmont

A Brief Summary of This Position:

The primary function of this position is to ensure the company’s compliance with Brazil tax laws and regulations and to assist in satisfying its tax filing obligations. The position will involve working with various areas of tax including, but not limited to, federal tax, state and local tax, and ASC 740.The position will assist in helping compile the quarterly and annual tax provision for the company, including gathering data from divisional sources and creating supporting workpapers and preparation of corporate federal and state income tax returns. This position will assist in the administration of the department’s tax provisioning and compliance softwares. The Manager, Tax role requires a working knowledge of current tax laws and a willingness to expand that knowledge base through various resources provided by the company.

Essential Functions:

  • This position reports to the Director Federal Tax and has no direct or indirect reports but could evolve to have direct reports in the future.
  • The role requires up to 5% domestic travel, including overnight stays.

Federal Tax Compliance

  • Assist with the preparation and filing of the corporate federal income tax returns and related work papers.
  • Prepare quarterly federal estimated tax payment.
  • Research transactions of an unusual nature as they arise.
  • Ensure all filing dates are met to satisfy tax compliance obligations.
  • Determine 1099-MISC taxable amounts for the members of the board of directors.
  • File federal withholding forms and deposit payments related to board of directors.

State Tax Compliance

  • Prepare corporate state income tax returns and related work papers.
  • Prepare quarterly state estimated tax payments.
  • Monitor and implement law changes in relevant jurisdictions.
  • Research transactions of an unusual nature as they arise.
  • Review nexus activities by each legal entity on a periodic basis for tax compliance.
  • File Brazil withholding forms and deposit payments related to board of directors.

ASC 740 – Accounting for Income Taxes

  • Compile and review tax accounting work papers on quarterly basis.

You will manage the new business cycle through prospecting, qualification, needs analysis, stakeholder mapping, pitching and negotiation. Once contracts are won, you will roll out the optimum operating model to get client engagement up and running to execute plans. You will work with a range of stakeholders, Products specialists, finance and legal, as well as senior members within client organizations.

What we expect from you:

  • Successful track record, 5+ years, of delivering new business targets in a tech / consulting environment
  • A strong network of senior contacts within grocery retailers and CPG's (plus)
  • Building great relationships with new client stakeholders, establishing trust and becoming a true partner
  • Consultative approach to selling, identifying needs and selling customer-first solutions
  • Great collaboration with colleagues

What You Can Expect From Us

We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.

And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. Please let us know how we can make this process work best for you.

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

Na Loma nossa prioridade é proteger os sonhos e as realizações dos nossos associados e trabalhamos duro pra isso acontecer! Alem disso nossa dedicação é incansável em busca do desenvolvimento e crescimento da nossa equipe de colaboradores, prestadores e parceiros!

Para nós, proteger o patrimônio das pessoas é a melhor forma de ajuda-las a progredir e prosperar financeiramente.

Por isso levamos até elas uma proteção completa, sem burocracia e com condição de pagamento facilitada.

Estamos revolucionando a forma do Brasileiro proteger seu patrimônio e ter acesso a um serviço de qualidade!

Criamos um movimento que não para diante da burocracia e que não fica refém de um monopólio banqueiro.

Crescemos mais de 140% no ano de 2022 e mais de 100% em 2023 e 24 nossa meta para 2025 é ainda mais audaciosa.

Temos uma visão bem definida e, para isso, trabalhamos todos os dias com o objetivo de entregar os melhores benefícios e proteções aos nossos associados, para que por qualidade, benefícios e indicações consigamos levar nossa proteção a 100 mil pessoas.

Para alcançarmos nosso objetivo estamos sempre nos aprimorando na entrega de um serviço sem burocracia, prático e de extrema qualidade.

title: Senior Director Data Engineering
description:
Senior Director, Data Engineering - Professional Services - Consulting (Brazil)

About phData

phData is an AI-forward engineering company focused on getting enterprise data and AI workloads in production for some of the largest and most well-known companies in the world.

We specialize in the most complex data, machine learning, and AI problems that only the best engineers can solve. From the top down, we’re built and run by hardcore data, ML, and AI engineers.

  • Founders and leadership teams wrote books on databases and built key open-source tools, including Kafka, Parquet, Hive, and more.
  • We are a partner to major cloud data platforms like Snowflake (6X POTY), AWS, Azure, GCP, Fivetran, dbt, OpenAI, Anthropic, and more.
  • We have nearly 700 employees operating across 3 continents, and we’re growing quickly.
  • We build AI and automation tools that no other consulting company has, enabling us to do more with smaller teams and without sacrificing quality.
  • We are not staff aug. We are a premium provider of data and AI services and our clients pay to work with the best teams.

Our Core Values

  • Grit. We make sacrifices and accomplish the mission no matter what, because greatness demands commitment.
  • Psychological Safety. We take risks, try new things, and have uncomfortable conversations without fear. We know that failure is the mother of success.
  • Curiosity. We seek genuine feedback and assume positive intent. We challenge assumptions, explore boldly, and never settle for “good enough” or “because we’ve always done it that way”.
  • Community. We do the work to help the team, not to collect personal recognition. No task is beneath us, and no ego is above the work. If something needs doing, we do it—whether or not anyone notices.

About the Role

This person will act as the technical leader for phData’s most strategic clients. This is among the most challenging, highest-profile, and highest-value roles in all of phData.

Why is this one of the most challenging? This person must have a versatile arsenal of skills, technical knowledge, and communication styles. It’s more than saying the right thing. The Technical Account Lead must also be able to write code, stay up to date with the latest developments in technology, and lead and motivate a team to respond to the challenges and high expectations of our clients.

If our clients could solve these problems themselves, they would. Instead, they hire phData. We see ourselves as the client’s special forces and do what it takes to complete the mission. The Technical Account Lead doesn’t just get into the weeds—they study the entire root system.

This person needs to proactively give feedback internally and externally. They need to make sure we have the right people and the best teams. They will interface at the executive level, tackling uncomfortable conversations head-on and through a lens of respect, ownership, and integrity.

Our ultimate goal is to make our clients say “wow”. The ultimate measure of success for a Technical Account Lead is when a client chooses to extend projects with us and expand into new projects and workloads with us. The Technical Account Lead is personally accountable for converting highly strategic first-time engagements into multi-year partnerships, and growing strategic clients into $10M+ in annual value.

About You

  • You’ve been the person others relied on to make the hard technical calls and guide execution at scale.
  • You can sit across from a Fortune 500 CTO, ask door-opening questions, and confidently recommend a roadmap that changes how they think about data or AI.
  • You are client-obsessed. You know the history, business context, and org structure of whoever you work with.
  • You know greatness doesn’t come from working 9 to 5.
  • You know that giving and receiving feedback, internally and externally, is your fastest path to excellence and meaningful relationships.
  • You are a builder. You aren’t looking for a company that has it all figured out already. You want to have a voice in building something great.
  • You thrive on and grow through change.
  • You want to work alongside the brightest minds in data and AI.

Job Requirements

  • Act as the executive-level technical leader for a set of strategic clients, operating like the account’s CTO: owning technology direction, technical stakeholder relationships, and strategic alignment.
  • Build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders through 1:1s, on-site visits, and active engagement across initiatives.
  • Lead key client events (e.g., QBRs, Innovation Days, workshops) and contribute content that connects strategic goals with technical execution.
  • Develop and maintain a technology strategy and roadmap tailored to the client’s goals, providing hands-on architectural guidance when needed.
  • Partner closely with the account team to drive growth by collaborating on strategy and opportunity creation.
  • Write and guide scopes, proposals, and pricing estimates. Enable other leaders to do the same using phData’s processes and templates.
  • Create and present clear deliverables (e.g. architecture diagrams, enablement docs, POVs) that drive alignment from execs to practitioners.
  • Help the client operationalize data and AI projects—ensuring ideas move from prototype to production with measurable business impact.
  • Act as the ultimate owner of technical success for the client:
  • Resolve technical and strategic escalations across delivery and act as a point of accountability for both phData and the client
  • Hold delivery quality to a high standard, onboard new team members effectively, and continuously identify areas for improvement
  • Track and report KPIs that demonstrate client success and business value; use data to inform strategy and improve delivery
  • Meet minimum billable utilization requirements within book of business
  • Educate internal teams on successful delivery patterns and contribute to phData’s internal playbooks, QBR content, and sales collaboration.
  • Cultivate and manage relationships with key technology partners.
  • BA/BS in computer science, engineering, business, operations, or related fields preferred.
  • Must have demonstrated experience leading highly technical engineering teams or serving as the chief architect in a complex, hands-on technical environment.
  • Travel up to 35% (client-dependent).

Sustentabilidade e inovação estão no DNA do Grupo Boticário — e você pode fazer parte dessa transformação. Você terá a oportunidade de atuar na identificação e aplicação de alternativas seguras e sustentáveis para matérias-primas, considerando aspectos ambientais, regulatórios e de segurança humana. Seu trabalho será essencial para garantir a performance, qualidade e viabilidade econômica das soluções, contribuindo para o cumprimento dos compromissos 2030 do Grupo Boticário.

Se você deseja aplicar seu conhecimento técnico em um ambiente colaborativo e inovador, liderando iniciativas que unem ciência, propósito e impacto real no mercado, e quer contribuir para uma indústria de cosméticos mais sustentável, essa vaga é para você.

  • Avaliação das matérias primas e materiais de embalagens controversas que precisam de substituição bem como o estudo das fórmulas e composições que serão aplicadas.

Job Summary: biwin is recruiting an HR Manager specifically dedicated to supporting our rapidly growing consumer brand business. The ideal candidate will develop and implement effective HR strategies to attract, develop, and retain talent needed for the consumer products market. This position is crucial for building a dynamic and consumer-centric team culture.

Key Responsibilities:

• Talent Acquisition:

o Design and implement recruitment strategies to attract top talent from consumer goods and retail industries

o Collaborate with department heads to determine staffing needs and job descriptions

o Establish diverse recruitment channels, including social media and industry networks

• Employee Development:

o Implement training programs to enhance consumer product sales and marketing skills

o Create individual development plans to support career growth and succession planning

o Design onboarding programs specific to consumer business

• Performance Management:

o Establish performance evaluation systems aligned with consumer business objectives

o Provide performance feedback and guidance to improve team effectiveness

o Monitor employee satisfaction and address potential issues

• Culture Building:

o Foster a positive, innovative, and consumer-centric organizational culture

o Organize team-building activities and employee engagement initiatives

o Ensure the work environment supports creativity and collaboration

• Compensation & Benefits:

o Develop competitive compensation structures to attract and retain talent

o Monitor industry compensation trends and recommend adjustments

o Manage employee benefit programs and incentives

• Compliance Management:

o Ensure HR practices comply with relevant laws and regulations

o Maintain employee records and HR documentation

o Handle employee relations issues and conflict resolution

Qualifications:

• 5+ years of HR management experience, preferably with background in consumer goods or retail sectors

• Extensive experience in recruitment, training, and employee development

• In-depth understanding of performance management and talent development

• Outstanding interpersonal skills and conflict resolution abilities

• Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field

• HR certifications preferred

• Proficiency in creating positive team cultures

title: Agente de Negócios - Representante Comercial PJ | Açu - RN
description:
Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time

Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia, referência na América Latina. Com soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente, com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Contamos com o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios e o iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre na vanguarda, com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário

Nesta posição, você será o ponto de conexão entre o iFood e novos parceiros de negócios. Seu dia a dia será guiado por estratégias de expansão, conquistando novos clientes em áreas com grande potencial de crescimento.

Entre as principais responsabilidades, você irá:

  • Prospecção de novos parceiros: Identificar oportunidades de mercado e atrair restaurantes e estabelecimentos para o ecossistema iFood.
  • Gestão de funil de vendas: Realizar acompanhamento detalhado do pipeline, assegurando a conversão em cada etapa.
  • Acompanhamento contínuo: Manter contatos regulares e estruturados com potenciais clientes para estreitar relacionamentos.
  • Gestão de relacionamento: Ser referência no atendimento às demandas dos parceiros, garantindo uma experiência incrível desde o início.
  • Colaboração estratégica: Trabalhar de forma integrada com o time para maximizar resultados e impulsionar a presença do iFood na cidade de Açu - RN .

Ingredientes que Buscamos

  • Experiência em vendas: Um diferencial será ter atuado com vendas externas, prospecção ou gestão de carteira.
  • Comunicação excepcional: Habilidade oral e escrita para interações via telefone, WhatsApp e e-mail.
  • Perfil organizado e resiliente: Energia, senso de dono e capacidade de se adaptar a um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Habilidade de negociação e persuasão: Capacidade de argumentar e buscar resultados acima da média, sempre com foco no cliente.
  • Relacionamento interpessoal: Facilidade em criar conexões significativas e construir parcerias de longo prazo.
  • Morar na cidade e ter como se locomover: Ser residente da cidade de Açu - RN e possuir mobilidade para realizar deslocamentos com facilidade.

Sobre Nós

No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e alcançar #Resultados incríveis. Por isso, valorizamos candidatos independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Temos grupos compostos por foodlovers voluntários, onde falamos sobre Raça, Gênero, LGBTQI+ e PcD. Queremos ser a empresa onde as pessoas escolham se desenvolver e realizar seus sonhos. #AllTogether.

Conheça nossas iniciativas | Institucional iFood

Você Tem Fome de Quê?

Temos fome de inovação e resultados. Sempre buscamos fazer o nosso melhor, pensando "fora da caixa" e agindo com agilidade e responsabilidade. Valorizamos a diversidade, o conhecimento e o compartilhamento em um ambiente dinâmico e versátil. O ingrediente especial da nossa receita? As pessoas. Vem fazer parte disso!

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Departamento Pessoal
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Coordenar rotinas de folha de pagamento, encargos, férias, rescisões e benefícios;
  • Garantir conformidade com legislação trabalhista e previdenciária;
  • Atuar como ponto focal do eSocial e obrigações acessórias;
  • Liderar equipe técnica, promovendo autonomia e desenvolvimento;
  • Apoiar na implementação de melhorias de processos e sistemas;
  • Colaborar com áreas de RH, Jurídico e Financeiro.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, RH, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência em Departamento Pessoal, com atuação em cargos de liderança;
  • Domínio de sistemas de folha (LG Cloud) e legislação trabalhista;
  • Perfil colaborativo, organizado e com foco em resultados;
  • Experiência com projetos de transformação digital ou automação de processos;
  • Diferencial: Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Pessoas ou áreas correlatas.

O Que Temos Para Você

title: Sales Manager
description:
Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !

Job Overview:

We are seeking for an experienced, dynamic and strategic Sales Manager to play a key role in a challenging channel, balancing the sell-in and sell-out results with key accounts, fostering for growth opportunities and categories development working together internal business and support areas.

Opportunities to work with several areas of the company that interacts with sales, such as: finance, logistics, legal, SCM, marketing, channel among others.

Key Job Responsibilities:

  • Build, by customer, sales & execution plan: Sell-in & Sell-Out Targets, Operations KPIs, S&OP, and ensuring compliance with these targets.
  • Lead regular meetings with customer to present targets, KPIs and define action plan to leverage results.
  • Relationship/interaction with all areas that interact with customers: Finance, Logistics, Sales Management, Legal, etc.
  • Attend, with operation team, internal meeting to define Channel Sales Forecast.
  • Visit stores with our Partners to identify opportunities at POS.
  • Development and enhancement of online and digital platform of customers.
  • Assemble business opportunities with customers and other partners.
  • Ability to manage different demands at the same time, demonstrating good judgement in defining priorities.

Background & Experience

  • Bachelor degree: Business, Engineering, Marketing or a related.
  • Experience in Sales, Trade Marketing.
  • Experience with Retail "large accounts" is a mandatory.
  • Minimum 7-10 years of experience in sales management
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

title: Implementation/Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Implementation / Forward Deployed Engineer - Canada, Mexico, South America - Remote

About us

VERSA AI is an innovative and fast-growing start-up in the Contact Center automation space - designing and deploying next generation voice Ai Agents. We’re on a mission to build and support the Contact Center of the future using the power of Ai to create beautiful conversations between humans and machines.

Our technology helps clients deliver exceptional customer experiences whilst simultaneously cutting costs and managing growth. An Australian-founded business with a strong foothold in the US, we are looking to expand our operations and build out our team on the ground in this critical market. We are looking for passionate, entrepreneurial individuals who are eager to make a significant impact in a dynamic and fast-moving environment.

Who we are looking for

A versatile Full Stack Engineer who can move from discovery to delivery with minimal hand-holding. You are strongest in Node.js on AWS, comfortable with IaC, and fluent in stitching together APIs, LLMs, SIP telephony and cloud services to ship reliable, production value fast. You think in systems, automate what repeats, and write clear, testable code. You enjoy working directly with clients, translating goals into pragmatic workflows, then owning the build, rollout and measurement. You communicate crisply with both engineers and non-technical partners, collaborate with internal stakeholders, and leave things better than you found them through improved tooling, documentation and dashboards.

Required Experience:

  • 5 - 8 years of professional engineering experience, ideally across full-stack development and you have a strong understanding of engineering principles.
  • Strong background in system integration, workflow automation, and API-driven development utilising Node.js and AWS.
  • Proven ability to work directly with clients and colleagues, build trust, and translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Exceptional communication skills to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced environments with a high level of autonomy. Working independently is highly important in this role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Integration between LLM’s, SIP Telephony, API endpoints and cloud infrastructure (AWS) using mostly NodeJs and IAC.
  • Partner with clients to design and implement automation workflows that align with their roadmap upon onboarding of new clients.
  • Develop, integrate, and maintain full-stack features to deliver immediate value in production.
  • Act as both engineer and consultant: uncovering client challenges, advising on solutions, and building them in collaboration with the clients technical team.
  • Collaborate internally with the Customer Success and Conversation Design teams to translate to technical requirements and ensure seamless delivery.
  • Contribute to improving internal tooling, documentation and frameworks for faster client implementations.

What success looks like

In the first 30 days you will map our architecture, run the product locally and in staging, and set yourself up with logs and monitoring. You will close a first batch of low risk tickets, ship a couple of small peer-reviewed fixes, and improve at least one run book.

In the next few months, you will be a trusted technical support partner who triages and resolves incidents end to end, consistently meets SLAs, and owns a service area with clear dashboards and documentation. You will reduce repeat issues through small automations or fixes, contribute to RCAs, and share knowledge with the team.

The benefits

The Versa Group has been recognised both in Australia and internationally for

creating a highly innovative environment for our employees. In 2019 Versa were

named as only one of eight companies outside of the US in Fast Company’s Top 50

Workplaces for Innovators.

  • Be part of a fast-growing start-up with a dynamic and innovative culture.
  • Opportunity for significant professional growth and career advancement.
  • Competitive salary and commission structure.
  • Highly flexible work environment with a ‘remote first’ company

We believe that diversity is critical to our success. We will not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.

A área de Auditoria tem como missão ampliar a cobertura de riscos por meio do desenvolvimento de indicadores que avaliam a aderência dos processos e a efetividade dos controles, garantindo a identificação tempestiva na exposição de riscos que possam impactar a Instituição Financeira.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de indicadores de risco;
  • Análise de dados para identificação de padrões e anomalias;
  • Criação de dashboards interativos e relatórios gerenciais;
  • Apoio na implementação de soluções baseadas em IA e automação;
  • Realização de trabalhos voltado em processos utilizando LLM;
  • Aplicar boas práticas e Governança em seus processos como Documentação Técnica.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação completa em Ciências da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática, Administração e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação em Data Analytics, Inteligência Artificial ou Gestão de Riscos (diferencial);
  • Linguagens de programação: SQL e Python (para análise e automação);
  • Ferramentas de visualização: Power BI (Data Viz);
  • Controle de versão: GitHub/GitLab (Commits);
  • Técnicas de Inteligência Artificial: Machine Learning, Deep Learning e GenAI;
  • Vivência: Data Lake e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.

Informações adicionais

  • Trilhas de capacitação acadêmica e técnica;
  • Oportunidade de encarreiramento;
  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação;
  • Convênio médico e odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Condições especiais em nossos produtos financeiros;
  • Auxílio Creche / Babá;

title: SDR

title: Consultor Protheus - Especialista em Livros Fiscais (Configurador de Tributos)
description:
Vaga: Consultor Protheus – Especialista em Livros Fiscais (Configurador de Tributos) / Remoto

Empresa: Bee IT

Posição: Consultor Especialista em TOTVS Protheus – Módulo Livros Fiscais / Configurador de Tributos (SIGAFIS / FISA170)

Regime: 100 % Remoto

Localização: Brasil (horário de Brasília)

Perfil Desejado

  • Experiência comprovada no módulo Livros Fiscais (SIGAFIS) do Protheus e na rotina Configurador de Tributos (FISA170) para parametrização de regras fiscais.
  • Habilidade para configurar tributos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS etc.), regras de alíquota, vigência, exceções e fórmulas de cálculo no ambiente do Configurador de Tributos.
  • Capacidade de migrar regras fiscais antigas (TES) para o Configurador de Tributos e validar cálculos durante o período de transição.
  • Experiência com integração entre módulo fiscal e demais rotinas do Protheus (Faturamento, Compras, Contabilidade) para garantir que os cálculos tributários sejam refletidos corretamente nas operações.
  • Perfil consultivo, com boa comunicação, autonomia e senso de revisão, já que erros fiscais podem ter impacto contábil / tributário.

✅ Atribuições

  • Implantar, configurar e dar suporte ao Configurador de Tributos (FISA170) dentro do módulo Livros Fiscais do Protheus (SIGAFIS);
  • Mapear regras fiscais existentes, migrar configurações da TES ou outras rotinas legadas para o novo modelo de Configurador;
  • Validar cenários tributários (venda, compra, devolução), simular impactos, testar e homologar configurações antes de irem para produção;
  • Assegurar a integração de tributos nas operações de faturamento, compras e contabilidade, garantindo que os valores apurados sejam refletidos nos módulos corretos;
  • Treinar usuários, documentar configurações fiscais e guiar ajustes em função de legislações novas ou mudanças tributárias;
  • Monitorar atualizações fiscais e propor ajustes preventivos no sistema.

title: Project Manager
description:
Company Description

Charly Agency is a globally operating digital agency based in Barcelona, Spain. We specialize in providing top-quality design, technology, and marketing services to drive businesses to success. Our clientele is 90% based in the USA. Our commitment to excellence is evident in client testimonials, highlighting our responsiveness, dedication, and impressive results. Our key capabilities include web design, web and mobile app design, brand strategy and design, ecommerce and CRO, web development and maintenance, SEO, and content writing.

Role Description

This position at Charly Agency offers a dynamic opportunity. As a Project Manager, you'll lead diverse digital projects, from web design and development to UX design and branding. You’ll coordinate closely with cross-functional teams, ensuring deliverables meet the highest quality standards. This role is not limited to traditional project management; it requires a hands-on approach—whether supporting the team with copywriting, compiling reports, or conducting quality assurance checks.

We’re looking for someone detail-oriented and adaptable, with the ability to see the big picture, a great sense of ownership, and an understanding of how individual tasks contribute to overall project success. Strong communication skills are essential for liaising with designers, developers, clients, and internal team members, ensuring that all deliverables align with our standards and client expectations.

This is a remote contractor position.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management:

  • Plan, execute, and oversee digital projects from inception to completion, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and to high-quality standards.
  • Coordinate with designers, developers, and technical teams to align project goals and deliverables.
  • Conduct thorough quality assurance checks to ensure all deliverables meet client and agency standards.
  • Monitor project timelines and resources, addressing any deviations proactively.
  • Follow up diligently with team members to ensure progress aligns with project milestones.

Hands-On Contribution:

  • Support with content tasks, such as drafting or reviewing copy.
  • Assist in compiling and analyzing reports to provide insights to clients or internal teams.
  • Be prepared to learn new skills and adapt to emerging project needs.

Communication:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, maintaining clear and effective communication.
  • Translate technical or design concepts into terms easily understood by all stakeholders.
  • Facilitate collaboration across teams, ensuring everyone is aligned and informed.

Qualifications

  • 2-5 years of experience in project management within digital agencies, product development, web design, UX design, or related fields.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to see the broader strategic picture.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in English.
  • Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong organizational skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Basic understanding of web design and development processes.
  • Flexibility to adapt to evolving project requirements and learn new tools or methods as needed.
  • International exposure (work or study abroad, exchange programs) is a plus.

What We Offer

  1. Meaningful Impact: Contribute directly to projects that shape the trajectory of the company and its clients.
  2. Engaging Work: Take on diverse tasks and challenging projects in a fast-paced environment.
  3. Flexibility: Enjoy the benefits of a remote position with flexible working hours.
  4. Competitive Compensation Package:
  • Salary: $1,500-$2,000 per month based on experience, composed of a base salary and performance bonuses.
  • Communication Support: Receive $50 monthly to cover communication expenses.
  1. Generous PTO: Take advantage of 3 weeks of paid time off per year to recharge and pursue personal interests.

Application Process

To apply you can do a quick apply on linkedin or, preferably send your CV, cover letter, and a 1-minute video introducing yourself and your experience to using the subject: “Project Manager Application - (Your Full Name).”

We look forward to reviewing your application and assessing your fit for this exciting role!

title: Baker Role - 42981
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview

Turing is seeking baking professionals to join the Common Lives Project —a research initiative to collect real-world footage that trains AI systems. You and a colleague from the same bakery or workspace will wear GoPro cameras while baking and managing prep throughout the day.

Responsibilities:

  • Wear a head-mounted GoPro camera to capture daily activities for 5 separate days within a 2-week window
  • Record a minimum of 7 hours per day, with flexibility to take breaks and pause the camera for privacy
  • At the end of each day, spend around 2 hours to:
  • Upload your footage to a secure platform
  • Review short clips
  • Choose to delete, anonymize, or consent to each video segment

Household Requirements:

  • No children (under 18) present or visiting during the recording period
  • All adults in the space must be fluent English speakers and consent to being recorded
  • Must live in a private, self-contained apartment, building, or indoor work environment
  • All household members must agree to appear in the footage

Participant Requirements:

  • Must work indoors in non-customer-facing roles (e.g., not retail or child care)
  • Participants who share the same workplace or household should both have a GoPro mounted during the activity.
  • Preferably engaged in manual or creative work (e.g., chef, baker, artist, carpenter, musician, electrician, mechanic)
  • Must be self-employed or have employer consent to record in the work environment
  • Able to use a computer for basic tasks such as reviewing and uploading video clips

Technical Requirements:

  • Must have access to a computer and internet connection
  • Comfortable using web-based tools for uploading and reviewing clips (training will be provided)
  • GoPro camera and all accessories will be provided for the duration of the project

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Play a vital role in shaping the future of human-centered AI research
  • Short-term, flexible engagement with minimal disruption to your routine
  • All equipment provided by Turing
  • Be part of an innovative global data collection initiative

Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 5 recording days within a 2-week window
  • Engagement Type: Contractor / Freelance
  • Duration: 2 weeks (plus setup and review time)
  • Location: India, Brazil, Colombia

Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a brief screening
  • Once accepted, Turing will ship all necessary equipment and provide onboarding instructions
  • Participants will receive training on how to record, upload, and review their footage securely

description:

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer with deep expertise in AWS cloud infrastructure to strengthen our DevOps culture and help scale our systems securely and reliably.

You’ll be a key driver of automation, scalability, observability, and security for our cloud-based infrastructure, working closely with software engineers to streamline deployments and operations. You will also play a central role in preparing our infrastructure for regulatory compliance, licenses, and security audits, ensuring we meet the highest standards of reliability and trust.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable and secure cloud infrastructure on AWS .
  • Develop and optimize IaC (Infrastructure as Code) pipelines.
  • Ensure observability and monitoring across services and environments.
  • Implement security best practices and compliance controls across infrastructure.
  • Support and prepare systems for external audits and licensing requirements .
  • Improve CI/CD workflows and accelerate developer productivity.
  • Lead and mentor junior engineers in DevOps best practices.

What We’re Looking For

  • Senior-level experience in DevOps and cloud infrastructure.
  • Proven expertise in AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, Lambda, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudFormation/Terraform, etc.).
  • Strong background in a utomation, scalability, and system reliability.
  • Knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern monitoring stacks.
  • Strong security-first mindset and experience with compliance or audit-ready infrastructure.
  • Advanced English proficiency, for effective communication in international contexts and during audits/compliance processes.

Why Join Us

  • At Bloquo, you’ll work at the intersection of cloud, payments, and blockchain innovation. You’ll have the autonomy to design world-class infrastructure and the chance to shape the reliability and security of systems that enable cross-border transactions in real time, ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory and licensing requirements.

Além dos controles de caixa e riscos, a Tesouraria tem como objetivo a constante avaliação do melhor modelo de gestão de recursos e a otimização o P&L da empresa, por meio da diversificação das estratégias de investimentos e captações de recursos com taxas e spreads mais competitivas.

Realizar a prática da coleta seletiva no setor, cumprir com a política, objetivos, procedimentos e diretrizes ambientais, ter conhecimento dos seus aspectos e impactos ambientais significativos, contribuir com melhorias voltadas a proteção do meio ambiente e multiplicar o conhecimento sobre as melhores práticas ambientais sempre que possível a todos os colaboradores que atuam em sua área.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.

  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Trazer novos clientes para o canal, com perfil Grandes Contas .
  • Atuar no funil inteiro de vendas, desde prospecção, qualificação e negociação.
  • Acompanhar e analisar relatórios de atividades, assim como a eficiência do canal considerando dois KPIS, Volume Total de Pagamentos e Receitas.

description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

As a Software Engineer focused on Artificial Intelligence, you will make a significant contribution to the construction of innovative AI Agents by collaborating closely with your engineering peers. This role requires a high degree of creative thinking and a strong willingness to learn, as you will be working with the latest in Generative AI tools and frameworks. The Agentic AI Engineer explores emerging technologies, promotes new development approaches, and helps shape the standards for intelligent automation, playing a fundamental role in advancing the company's AI-driven solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of autonomous AI Agents, leveraging LLMs, advanced techniques such as RAG, and agent-specific frameworks;
  • Develop full-stack applications that support and interact with AI Agents, using JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Next.js to build the necessary interfaces and systems;
  • Explore and experiment with emerging technologies and frameworks in the agentic space, fostering innovation and shaping best practices;
  • Collaborate with product and design teams to define the behavior, capabilities, and goals of AI Agents, translating business requirements into robust agentic solutions;
  • Ensure code quality through rigorous reviews, testing, and documentation, while mentoring other engineers on development best practices.

Essential Skills

  • Solid experience in software engineering and full-stack development, with proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, and React;
  • Hands-on and up-to-date knowledge of Generative AI, including experience building and implementing features with LLMs in real-world products;
  • Strong foundation in software engineering principles, including system design, API architecture, code quality, and testing.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience in designing GenAI solutions architecture, agent frameworks, and advanced techniques such as RAG;
  • Knowledge of Natural Language Processing (NLP) applied to production-grade systems;
  • Familiarity with the Next.js ecosystem, deployment platforms like Vercel, and databases such as PostgreSQL;
  • Hands-on experience with modern UI component libraries like Shadcn/ui and TailwindCSS.

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

title: Artist Gig (Record & Earn $20/hr) - 42981
description:
Role Overview

Are you an artist working closely with another creator or assistant in your studio? Turing is looking for artists to wear GoPros and record their daily creative process as part of the Common Lives Project . This data will train AI to understand creativity, hands-on collaboration, and real-world artistic routines.

Responsibilities

  • Wear a head-mounted GoPro camera to capture daily activities for 5 separate days within a 2-week window
  • Record a minimum of 7 hours per day, with flexibility to take breaks and pause the camera for privacy
  • At the end of each day, spend around 2 hours to:
  • Upload your footage to a secure platform
  • Review short clips
  • Choose to delete, anonymize, or consent to each video segment

Household Requirements:

  • No children (under 18) present or visiting during the recording period
  • All adults in the space must be fluent English speakers and consent to being recorded
  • Must live in a private, self-contained apartment, building, or indoor work environment
  • All household members must agree to appear in the footage

Participant Requirements:

  • Must work indoors in non-customer-facing roles (e.g., not retail or child care)
  • Participants who share the same workplace or household should both have a GoPro mounted during the activity.
  • Preferably engaged in manual or creative work (e.g., chef, baker, artist, carpenter, musician, electrician, mechanic)
  • Must be self-employed or have employer consent to record in the work environment
  • Able to use a computer for basic tasks such as reviewing and uploading video clips

Technical Requirements:

  • Must have access to a computer and internet connection
  • Comfortable using web-based tools for uploading and reviewing clips (training will be provided)
  • GoPro camera and all accessories will be provided for the duration of the project

Perks of Freelancing With Turing

  • Play a vital role in shaping the future of human-centered AI research
  • Short-term, flexible engagement with minimal disruption to your routine
  • All equipment provided by Turing
  • Be part of an innovative global data collection initiative

Offer Details

  • Commitment Required: 5 recording days within a 2-week window
  • Engagement Type: Contractor / Freelance
  • Duration: 2 weeks (plus setup and review time)
  • Location: India, Brazil, Colombia

Application Process

  • Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a brief screening
  • Once accepted, Turing will ship all necessary equipment and provide onboarding instructions
  • Participants will receive training on how to record, upload, and review their footage securely

kuubiik is a global consulting firm headquartered in Singapore, with operations in over 150 countries. Trusted by renowned brands like Google, TikTok, AEM, HP, TELUS, MyRepublic, and SGS, kuubiik offers flexible staffing solutions, ranging from hourly outsourcing to full-time or part-time engagements.

Job Title : Mobile Application Developer

Client location : US

Timezone : EST

Job type : Full-time, remote

Monthly salary : USD 1,500

Role Description

One of our clients is looking for a Frontend & Mobile Developer with deep expertise in JavaScript , React , and mobile frameworks like React Native and Flutter . This is a hands-on role with significant ownership over the frontend and mobile codebases across web and app platforms.

You'll be instrumental in shaping the future of our mobile and frontend experiences, with a focus on performance, scalability, and seamless cross-platform functionality.

  • Lead development of mobile apps using React Native (or Flutter during transition)
  • Maintain and evolve existing Ionic/Capacitor apps during migration phase
  • Build and maintain responsive frontend interfaces using React , HTML , CSS , and modern JavaScript
  • Integrate with backend services (Laravel, MySQL) and coordinate with backend team

  • Handle device-specific functionality: geolocation , camera/video , background services , notifications

  • Deep knowledge of mobile device features & APIs (camera, geolocation, background services, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with in-app payments , App Store / Play Store integrations

title: Head Professional Services
description:
Venha fazer parte do i4time para juntos, impulsionarmos o mercado segurador do Brasil com tecnologia e inovação!

O que fazemos?

A i4pro é líder em soluções tecnológicas para o mercado segurador e a única empresa brasileira que atende todos os ramos regulados pela Susep.

Oferecemos soluções de administração de apólice de ponta a ponta, com experiência SaaS.

Em2024, pelo quarto ano consecutivo, recebemos a certificação do Great Place to Work (GPTW).

i4pro + você = i4evc

Ao longo de sua jornada na i4pro, você terá diversas oportunidades para se desenvolver, evoluir e transformar, tudo isso em um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e saudável que preza pelo reconhecimento, valorização e bem-estar de todos. Assim, contamos com você para:

  • Liderar a área de Delivery da empresa, garantindo a execução eficiente e estratégica dos projetos de software.
  • Gerenciar equipes multidisciplinares , incluindo gerentes de projeto e especialistas em entrega, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alto desempenho.

  • Implementar metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, Agile) e boas práticas de gestão de projetos para otimizar processos e resultados.
  • Atuar como ponto focal estratégico entre clientes, áreas internas e stakeholders, garantindo alinhamento e comunicação eficaz.
  • Tomar decisões críticas sob pressão , mitigando riscos e mantendo os projetos no caminho certo.
  • Negociar com clientes e fornecedores , ajustando escopos e prazos conforme necessário para garantir o sucesso dos projetos, upsell.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho , satisfação do cliente e qualidade das entregas, promovendo melhorias contínuas.
  • Desenvolver e executar a visão estratégica da área de Delivery, alinhada aos objetivos de longo prazo da empresa e às necessidades do mercado de seguros.
  • Fomentar uma cultura de excelência , senso de urgência e foco em resultados em toda a equipe.

Você também precisa ter:

  • Experiência com metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos como Agile, Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Experiência em gestão de grandes equipes multidisciplinares e com mais de 2 níveis de liderança hierárquica
  • Formação superior em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Administração, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos, Gestão Empresarial, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas afins.
  • Inglês fluente.

Se você tiver, será um diferencial:

  • Diferencial vivência no setor de seguros.
  • Certificações profissionais em gerenciamento de projetos (por exemplo, PMP, PMI-ACP).

Nosso modelo de trabalho:

Priorizamos o bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores, com posições em formato remoto, presencial ou presencial com política de home office, que é definido conforme as necessidades da vaga e as atribuições do cargo.

No caso dessa posição, a atuação é de forma presencial com política de home office.

Nosso escritório fica na Avenida Angélica, 2133 – próximo do metrô Paulista.

O seu bem-estar é a nossa prioridade, portanto oferecemos:

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
The company and our mission:

Zartis is a digital solutions provider working across technology strategy, software engineering and product development.

We partner with firms across financial services, MedTech, media, logistics technology, renewable energy, EdTech, e-commerce, and more. Our engineering hubs in EMEA and LATAM are full of talented professionals delivering business success and digital improvement across application development, software architecture, CI/CD, business intelligence, QA automation, and new technology integrations.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on a project in the modern healthcare industry.

The project:

You will be joining the Booking team, contributing to a platform that simplifies healthcare appointment scheduling for millions of patients and providers. In this role, you’ll help shape how key information - such as insurance details - is collected and validated, ensuring a seamless booking journey.

Your work will center on evolving data models, improving system performance, and strengthening the reliability of a high-volume booking system. By collaborating with experienced engineers, you’ll extend and optimize microservices in the booking domain, driving scalability, cost efficiency, and stability. This is an opportunity to apply deep technical expertise while making a meaningful impact in a distributed, innovation-driven environment.

What you will do:

- Building large-scale APIs and microservices, creating frictionless data flows that empower both patients and providers to access care and information in real time.

- Mentoring fellow engineers, supercharging team throughput through robust coding standards, automated workflows, and a culture of continuous improvement.

- Spearheading bold innovation, whether it’s adopting generative AI, exploring emerging data sources, or pioneering architectural strategies that keep the platform ahead in healthcare tech.

- Decomposing complex product challenges to drive sound design decisions.

- Collaborating with an agile team of engineers, product managers, and designers.

- Working with cutting-edge GenAI tools and technology.

What you will bring:

- Inspiration to positively impact the healthcare experience of millions of patients and providers.

- A product-driven mindset with relentless focus on user needs.

- Strong autonomy, accountability, and comfort in a remote-first environment.

- Passion for engineering fundamentals and promoting best practices in code health, testing, and maintainability.

- Commitment to fostering diverse and inclusive teams and culture.

- Entrepreneurial spirit with strong ownership, thriving in fast-changing and ambiguous environments.

- Ability to craft database schemas, implement REST APIs, and design event-driven queue and stream processing systems, ideally with C#, .NET Core, and AWS.

- A history of solid and well-rounded system design skills.

- Leadership by example in testing, deployment, and observability practices.

- Excellent communication skills: able to dive into technical detail with engineers while presenting clear solutions to non-technical audiences.

- Comfort working with distributed teams.

- Experience integrating generative AI tools into daily workflows to automate tasks, drive innovation, and maximize productivity.

What we offer:

- 100% Remote Work.

- WFH allowance: Monthly payment as financial support for remote working.

- Career Growth: We have established a career development program accessible for all employees with a 360º feedback that will help us to guide you in your career progression.

- Training: For Tech training at Zartis, you have time allocated during the week at your disposal. You can request from a variety of options, such as online courses (from Pluralsight and Educative.io, for example), English classes, books, conferences, and events.

- Mentoring Program: You can become a mentor in Zartis or you can receive mentorship, or both.

- Zartis Wellbeing Hub (Kara Connect) : A platform that provides sessions with a range of specialists, including mental health professionals, nutritionists, physiotherapists, fitness coaches, and webinars with such professionals as well.

- Multicultural working environment: We organize tech events, webinars, parties, and activities to do online team-building games and contests.

  • Apoiar na construção do orçamento de remuneração e benefícios.
  • Criar e manter atualizadas as descrições de cargos.
  • Atuar na elaboração e implementação de políticas e diretrizes alinhadas às melhores práticas de mercado.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - React/Node.Js (remoto)
description:
Nosso cliente global em rastreamento de CCU busca Engenheiro(a) Sênior Fullstack (React + Node.js) para modernizar sua plataforma. Papel essencial em novos recursos, escalabilidade e boas práticas, atuando em infraestrutura AWS com foco em rastreabilidade e dados críticos. Vaga 100% remota, modelo de contratação é CLT. Inglês avançado obrigatório (interlocução com US).

O que procuramos:

O time de Engenharia busca Engenheiro(a) Sênior de Software para modernizar a plataforma e elevar a experiência do usuário. Atuação em novos recursos, escalabilidade e práticas de engenharia, desenvolvendo soluções em AWS que garantem dados e funcionalidades críticas aos clientes.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, manter e aprimorar uma plataforma de rastreamento de ativos resiliente, confiável e altamente disponível.
  • Fornecer liderança técnica por meio do conhecimento e compreensão de design e arquitetura de software.
  • Aplicar práticas ágeis, incentivando a colaboração, priorização e urgência para um desenvolvimento acelerado.
  • Contribuir para a visão da equipe de Software, ajudando a evoluir práticas e ferramentas.
  • Construir parcerias multidisciplinares com gerentes de produto, engenheiros de dados, sistemas e qualidade, além de parceiros de negócios, para desenvolver funcionalidades para os clientes.
  • Buscar diferentes perspectivas para impulsionar a inovação e construir consenso dentro da organização de engenharia de software.

Conhecimentos e Habilidades:

  • Experiência sólida com JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js.
  • Conhecimento em Ruby e Ruby on Rails .
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis híbridos para criar aplicações intuitivas e compatíveis com múltiplas plataformas.
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD, GitLab, Docker, AWS e Postgres .
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de APIs REST, GraphQL, micro frontends e microsserviços .
  • Familiaridade com o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software , incluindo definição de padrões, revisão de código, automação de testes, processos de build, monitoramento e alertas.
  • Capacidade de atuar com alto grau de autonomia, ao mesmo tempo em que trabalha em iniciativas estratégicas para a empresa.
  • Experiência com sistemas transacionais de alta demanda , onde desempenho e escalabilidade são essenciais.
  • Facilidade para aprender e se adaptar a novas tecnologias, auxiliando na transição para novas soluções.
  • Experiência com a metodologia ágil Scrum em um ambiente de equipe distribuída.
  • Conhecimento em IoT, dispositivos de rastreamento e telemática é um diferencial.
  • Inglês Fluente

Formação e Experiência:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • 7+ anos de experiência na área de Engenharia de Software.
  • Experiência demonstrada no desenvolvimento end-to-end de software, incluindo propriedade operacional .

description:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Atuar com desenvolvimento de software para o Segmento de Seguros.

Desenvolver produtos prezando pela experiência do usuário, segurança e consistência das informações.

title: General Manager Brazil - Seed Technologies
description:
Nufarm. Evolving Ag.

Nufarm is a global crop protection and seeds technologies company that helps farmers and businesses meet the global challenges of food, feed, fibre and food production.

Whether it’s developing the world’s first plant-based omega-3, launching precision agricultural solutions, unlocking biomass oils for more sustainable fuels and fast-moving consumer goods, launching innovative new crop protection solutions or delivering the crop and seed solutions farmers depend on every day, Nufarm is evolving with agriculture to drive value for customers.

Your Future. Fueled by Innovation

Reporting to the GM LAS, this role leads our Brazilian business end to end. You will set and execute the local commercial strategy, build a high-performing team, lift customer experience, strengthen the local supply chain, and drive the innovation pipeline to deliver both short-term results and long-term growth. This is a strong and growing business with significant future opportunities. You will also partner closely with the Nufarm Bioenergy platform lead and the Grain-to-Oil team to align and integrate plans, accelerating platform growth across Brazilian markets for the success of all portfolios.

As the GM, you will lead the Brazilian business, leveraging your expertise in the Brazilian seed industry and in-depth knowledge of business processes. Your key responsibilities include developing, refining, and implementing the three-year business strategy for the Brazilian Nufarm Seeds operations.

How You’ll Help Us Grow

  • Develop and grow the Brazilian team's commitment to prioritising health, safety and well-being
  • Lead a cross-functional leadership team of x across Brazil, Including: HR, Sales, Supply Chain, Market Development, Finance, Marketing/CX and Research & Development
  • Drive the development and implementation of the commercial strategy for the Brazilian business and grower adoption in sorghum, canola, carinata and energy cane.
  • Increase the addressable hybrid canola, sorghum, carinata and energy cane market through innovation and industry thought leadership.
  • Responsible for the P&L performance of the Brazilian Nufarm Seeds business.
  • Partner with the Nuseed Bioenergy platform lead, Global GM – Seeds and Grain-to-Oil team to integrate business plans and scale platform growth in Brazil
  • Ensure long range plans, budgets and forecasts are developed accurately and that the finance team partners with commercial and supply chain to meet the revenue and expense goals of the business.
  • Work with supply chain to ensure on-time delivery of high-quality canola seedwhile minimising obsolescence
  • Lead a thriving team across Brazil that continuously raises the bar. Work closely with managers to engage staff and build engagement while recruiting, developing and retaining top talent.
  • Work closely with local and global R&D team to support the portfolio development required. Understand and solve for the future challenges growers will face, ensuring our R&D efforts are focused on the traits we will need to successful on in future years.
  • Work with global business partners to strengthen the foundation of the business and drive for success.
  • Work to implement IBP and the surrounding analytics to ensure supply/demand decisions are made with all stakeholders in balance.
  • Work with internal and external grain-to-oil supply chain partners to identify pathways for integrating new platforms into the Brazilian business.
  • Create an enabling environment for new platforms (Bioenergy) through industry engagement and policy advocacy

title: Remote Junior Python Developer
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. title: Gerente de loja (São Paulo Capital)
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Buscamos pessoas que sejam movidas por paixões como a que inspirou o nascimento do Grupo, e que juntamente conosco, estejam dispostas a assumirem os desafios e continuarem escrevendo nossa história!

Somos uma empresa de igualdade de oportunidades. Isso significa que, ao tomar decisões sobre a carreira de nossos colaboradores, nossas principais considerações são sua capacidade de realizar seu trabalho e se desenvolver em suas funções.

Uma maneira de cultivar a mudança é criando um ambiente de trabalho mais diverso e inclusivo, como cultura organizacional. Para isso, estamos comprometidos em construir um ambiente que seja livre de discriminação e assédio onde todas as pessoas se sintam respeitadas e valorizadas.

Nós recrutamos pessoas de mente positiva que compartilham nossos valores fundamentais e nosso compromisso com Sustentabilidade.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

- Garantir a excelência no atendimento do cliente fidelizando o cliente com a marca e trazendo resultados para o atingimento de metas

- Acompanhar e orientar o time na jornada de vendas, interagindo e complementando quando visualiza oportunidades. Solucionar possíveis reclamações, trocas. Garantir que 100% da equipe realize os treinamentos online. Ser o multiplicador das estratégias da companhia, liderando pelo exemplo, sendo porta voz de todas as comunicações, garantindo a alta qualidade nos atendimentos

- Realizar o controle financeiro, fazendo depósitos semanais e preenchimento de planilhas, assim como controle do caixinha, prezando pelos gastos da loja afim de diminuir despesas. Coordenar a virada da operação a cada campanha dentro dos prazos e seguindo orientações da MMP (material de merchandising promocional) , além de manter a loja atrativa para o cliente (organização, precificação, limpeza, estrutura)

- Garantir o atingimento das metas e KPIs do time da loja, mantendo a rentabilidade dentro do esperado.

- Reportar diretamente ao Supervisor ou Gerente Distrital movimentações da concorrência, oportunidades da praça que a operação esta localizada, buscar parcerias na região. Participar das reuniões, construção de plano de ação, trabalhando estrategicamente no atingimento dos resultados. Buscar desenvolver o time em busca de um sucessor para a sua posição

-Realizar a gestão de todo o time, desenvolvendo e engajando os profissionais. Recrutar e selecionar funcionários para a equipe, reportar ao RH dados em relação ao ponto eletrônico e ser o principal vínculo com a área sempre que necessário para que o time esteja completo e munido de informações referente ao RH.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

- Ensino Médio Completo

- Experiência com vendas, gestão de pessoas e indicadores

- Necessário disponibilidade e flexibilidade de horário

- Desejável experiência no segmento de cosméticos, perfumaria e/ou produtos de beleza

- Escala 6X1

BENEFÍCIOS:

Nosso pacote de benefícios é:

-Vale Transporte

-Vale Refeição/Alimentação (R$ 775,00)

-Seguro de Vida

-Assistência Médica

-Assistência Odontológica

-TotalPass

-Convênio com o SESC

-Voucher de Aniversário

-Desconto nos produtos e SPA da marca

-Elleve (plataforma de incentivo educacional)
